solver.kind: blind AI solver (separate agent, answer-free packet, rubric v2)

S039-01.notes: Glancing at first page and not checking figures = superficial. Exhaustive is the opposite; hostile/innovative unsupported.

S039-02.notes: Neither side would budge = intransigent. Conciliatory is the opposite; indifferent and ambivalent contradict firm, opposed positions.

flags: minor: 'a kind of vortex never before seen in nature' is a slight overstatement of the 2018 Cummins et al. finding (a separated vortex ring not previously observed); acceptable for SAT purposes
S039-03.notes: The text describes the surprising separated vortex ring and how it slows the fall. A misreads (wind tunnels were the research tool); C and D are not discussed.

S039-04.notes: Spread followed social closeness (playmates, mother, then others), and the least-connected males were slowest, so transmission was social. A is too extreme ('completely', and some males did adopt it); B and C are unsupported, and C contradicts Imo being the originator.

flags: minor: '1900s' could be read as the whole century; the context implies decades, but '1900-1909' would be clearer
S039-05.notes: Rates: 1900s to 1950s is -10 over 5 decades (2/decade), 1950s to 2000s is -15 over 5 decades (3/decade), 2000s to 2010s is -7 in 1 decade (7/decade). C directly contrasts the early per-decade rate with the recent one. D's numbers actually also imply a faster recent rate (7 in one decade vs 15 in five), but D frames it as 'only... less', which presents it as evidence of slowing, so it fails as written. A and B show decline only, not acceleration. One defensible key.

S039-06.notes: A tests sound with moisture held constant, as the hypothesis requires. B shows the moisture response only; C is about seed yield; D has no sound stimulus. Consistent with Gagliano et al. 2017.

S039-07.notes: Text 2 attributes recovery to a drop in elk numbers from multiple causes and finds little avoidance behavior. A agrees with Text 1; C is too extreme ('no effect at all', and Text 2 says 'also'); D contradicts both texts. Accurately reflects the landscape-of-fear debate.

flags: minor: the notes say the movement's 'members' planted the trees, while D says the movement planted them; acceptable paraphrase
S039-08.notes: Only D gives a quantity (tens of millions of trees), which is the scale. The facts are accurate (1977, 2004 Nobel, first African woman).

S039-09.notes: Sleep mode is a response to low battery, a cause-and-effect relationship. Nonetheless implies contrast; Alternatively and Likewise do not fit.

S039-10.notes: An introductory participial phrase takes a comma before the main clause. A semicolon requires two independent clauses; a colon requires a preceding independent clause; a single dash is wrong here. The Inca road facts (about 40,000 km, no wheels or horses) are accurate.
